# Tonix Pharmaceuticals Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Operational Highlights


November 09, 2026 7:00am EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_d19aade8d78e7608d0aed0681a5bf4cd/tonixpharma/news/2026-11-09_Tonix_Pharmaceuticals_Reports_Third_Quarter_2026_1650.pdf)


### Related Documents


[Earnings Webcast](https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/y9c6svbp/)


[Audio](https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/y9c6svbp/)


*Third quarter TONMYA® net sales of approximately $15 million, up 37% from the second quarter*


*Approximately $163 million in cash and cash equivalents as of September 30, 2026*


*Strategic focus on supporting TONMYA growth and advancing core clinical programs*


*Conference call today at 8:30 a.m. ET*


BERKELEY HEIGHTS, N.J., Nov. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Tonix Pharmaceuticals Holding Corp. (Nasdaq: TNXP) (“Tonix” or the “Company”), a fully integrated, commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company, today announced financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and provided an overview of recent operational highlights.


“We delivered another strong quarter for TONMYA, with net sales up 37% over the second quarter,” said Seth Lederman, M.D., President and Chief Executive Officer of Tonix Pharmaceuticals. “Total prescriptions, new prescriptions, and refills also increased. Payer access expanded to include two commercial group purchasing organization (GPO) agreements, two managed Medicare agreements, and Medicaid access in almost every state. This expanded access contributed to third quarter sales growth. We have seen promising growth in our key performance indicators since adding 50 sales representatives on September 1, bringing our total sales force to approximately 150.”


“In addition to TONMYA’s growth, we are focused on our core clinical priorities,” Dr. Lederman continued. “Our priorities include advancing TNX-102 SL in major depressive disorder (MDD), TNX-4800 for Lyme disease prevention, and the investigator-initiated study of TNX-1500 (mosdaprubart)1 to prevent kidney transplant rejection.”


**TONMYA Updates** *TONMYA (cyclobenzaprine HCl sublingual tablets): a centrally acting, non-opioid analgesic approved for the treatment of fibromyalgia in adults; launched on November 17, 2025*


***Performance***


- Third quarter 2026 key performance metrics included:


- Total prescriptions increased 28% quarter-over-quarter to 16,375, including bridge prescriptions facilitated through the Company’s digital pharmacy channel. Bridge prescriptions represent initial patient fills provided while coverage determinations are pending and do not immediately generate net product revenue.
- New prescriptions increased 17% quarter-over-quarter.
- Refills increased 56% quarter-over-quarter.


***Payer Access and Coverage***


- TONMYA coverage now totals approximately 166 million covered lives (~53% of the approximately 314 million covered lives in the U.S.). The Company remains engaged with commercial payers, managed Medicare, and Medicaid to increase patient access.


- In July 2026, Tonix announced a major managed Medicare agreement, adding approximately nine million Medicare lives.
- In September 2026, Tonix announced a second major managed Medicare agreement, adding approximately 21 million Medicare lives.


***Execution***


- On September 1, 2026, the Company added 50 representatives to the TONMYA sales force, completing its planned expansion to approximately 150 sales representatives.
- On September 8, 2026, Tonix announced the promotion of Thomas Englese, MBA, to Chief Commercial Officer. Mr. Englese served as Executive Vice President, Commercial Operations, since September 2024.
- On October 2, 2026, the Company disclosed it had received notice from Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. and Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories, Inc. (collectively, DRL) that DRL had filed an Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA) containing a Paragraph IV patent certification with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for a generic version of TONMYA. The Company intends to vigorously enforce its intellectual property rights relating to TONMYA against infringement but cannot predict the outcome of this matter or guarantee the outcome of any litigation.


**Prioritized R&D Pipeline Updates**


***Central Nervous System (CNS)*** *TNX-102 SL (cyclobenzaprine HCl sublingual tablets): MDD*


- Enrollment is ongoing for HORIZON, a potentially pivotal, six-week, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2 study of TNX-102 SL 5.6 mg as a first-line monotherapy in adults with MDD.


***Infectious Disease*** *TNX-4800 (anti-OspA monoclonal antibody (mAb): long-acting human mAb in development for the seasonal prevention of Lyme disease in the U.S.*


- On August 3, 2026, Tonix announced receipt of positive official minutes from its Type C meeting with the FDA. The FDA is reviewing the final study protocol.
- The adaptive Phase 2 TRAIL field study is expected to begin in the first quarter of 2027 pending final FDA agreement on the study protocol.
- The Company is on track to deliver investigational product to the Phase 2 clinical study sites in the first quarter of 2027.


***Immunology*** *TNX-1500 (mosdaprubart) (dimeric Fc-modified humanized anti-CD40L mAb): Phase 2-ready third-generation anti-CD40L mAb in development to prevent kidney transplant rejection and treat autoimmune diseases*


- A Phase 2, open-label, investigator-initiated study at Massachusetts General Hospital (MGH) is expected to initiate in the first quarter of 2027 and enroll five adult kidney transplant recipients.


**Recent Financial Highlights** Tonix had approximately $163 million of cash and cash equivalents as of September 30, 2026, compared to approximately $207.6 million as of December 31, 2025. Net cash used in operating activities was approximately $125.6 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to approximately $60.2 million for the same period in 2025.


The Company believes that its cash resources as of September 30, 2026, together with the net proceeds of approximately $1.5 million raised from equity offerings subsequent to September 30, 2026, will meet its operating and capital expenditure requirements into the early third quarter of 2027.


As of November 6, 2026, the Company had 19,431,516 shares of common stock outstanding.


**Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results** Net product revenue for the third quarter 2026 was approximately $17.2 million, compared to $3.3 million for the same period in 2025, and consisted of combined net sales of TONMYA, Zembrace® SymTouch®, and Tosymra®. Net revenue from sales of TONMYA for the third quarter was approximately $15.0 million. Net revenue from sales of Zembrace SymTouch and Tosymra was approximately $2.2 million, compared to $3.3 million for the same quarter in 2025. Cost of sales for the third quarter 2026 was approximately $1.3 million, compared to $1.4 million for the same period in 2025. The decrease in cost of sales is driven by a change in product mix.


Research and development expenses for the third quarter 2026 were approximately $25.8 million, compared to $9.3 million for the same period in 2025. The increase of $16.5 million was primarily attributable to higher manufacturing expenses of $9.8 million, clinical expenses of $3.6 million and non-clinical expenses of $1.1 million as the Company advanced its prioritized pipeline, as well as higher employee-related costs of $1.5 million due to increased headcount.


Selling, general, and administrative expenses for the third quarter 2026 were approximately $45.6 million, compared to $25.7 million for the same period in 2025. The increase of $19.9 million was primarily attributable to higher sales and marketing expenses of $13.5 million, employee-related expenses of $4.1 million, and professional expenses of $1.5 million. These increases primarily reflect commercialization activities following the launch of TONMYA in November 2025.


Net loss available to common stockholders was $53.3 million, or $2.89 per basic and diluted share, for the third quarter 2026, compared to net loss available to common stockholders of $32.0 million, or $3.59 per basic and diluted share, for the same period in 2025. The basic and diluted weighted average common shares outstanding for the third quarter 2026 was 18,440,773 compared to 8,922,792 shares for the same period in 2025.

**Tonix Pharmaceuticals Holding Corp.** Tonix Pharmaceuticals* is a fully integrated, commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on central nervous system (CNS) disorders, infectious diseases, and immunology conditions with high unmet medical needs. TONMYA® (cyclobenzaprine HCl sublingual tablets 2.8 mg), the Company’s flagship internally conceived and developed medicine, is the first FDA-approved treatment for fibromyalgia in more than 15 years. Tonix’s CNS commercial infrastructure supports its marketed products, including its acute migraine products, Zembrace® SymTouch® (sumatriptan injection 3 mg) and Tosymra® (sumatriptan nasal spray 10 mg). Tonix is extending the science behind TONMYA in Phase 2 clinical studies to evaluate the potential of TNX-102 SL in major depressive disorder (Tonix-led study) and acute stress disorder/acute stress reaction (investigator-initiated study). Tonix is also advancing monoclonal antibody TNX-4800 (anti-OspA mAb) for Lyme disease prevention in the U.S. Within immunology, Tonix is developing TNX-1500 (anti-CD40L mAb), a third-generation CD40 ligand inhibitor for the prevention of kidney transplant rejection (investigator-initiated study). To learn more, visit[www.tonixpharma.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=4D5ZXOVf8fu1IElBByshQ26p-YCYby4WHaRNtVkkblNnzjwrecC18IIfHy_QqAo5zocEdweVIv10YNEmFeKqpEyiMs-x8XatSwdPOLAd-LY=) .


**Tonix’s product development candidates, including TNX-102 SL for new, unapproved indications, are investigational new drugs or biologics. Their efficacy and safety for the indications being investigated have not been established, and they have not been approved for those indications.*
